sources.title: British Virgin Islands entry requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: Current UK Government travel advice expressly limits its scope to full British citizen passport holders from the UK.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You can visit the BVI without a visa for up to 1 month.

policies.title: British Virgin Islands: full British citizen passports visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Current UK FCDO advice says people travelling on a full British citizen passport from the UK may visit BVI visa-free for up to one month.
conditions: This mapping is confined to the catalog’s GB full British citizen ordinary passport and a visit of up to one month; it is not a rule for every British nationality or BVI belonger status.
The BVI immigration authorities issue a one-month entry stamp on arrival; that stamp is not a visa-on-arrival classification.
From 1 January 2025, all travellers must complete the online embarkation card up to 72 hours before arrival. It is not an ETA or visa.
Extensions, work, residence, transit, cruise, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission rules are not normalized.
